arithmetic: Python double precision; no binary32 or GPU equivalence claim
analyticModel: finite cylinder front contact by closest approach plus spherical end caps; eye-inside rejection
independentOracle: point-to-finite-segment squared distance along normalized ray; 90 ternary minimization steps and 90 bisection entry steps

ranges.rayAim: uniform point on segment plus independent XY offsets in [-2*radius,2*radius], then normalized
